'''Ruth Haas''' is an American [[mathematician]] and professor at the [[University of Hawaii at Manoa]]. Previously she was the Achilles Professor of Mathematics at Smith College.<ref name="humphreys2015">{{cite web |title=Ruth Haas Honored with Humphreys Award |url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SIGfo1wo1e5HotJRBzlvHiSbHoDjlxzD/view?usp=sharing |publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics |accessdate=27 April 2019}}</ref> She received the [[M. Gweneth Humphreys Award]] from the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] (AWM) in 2015 for her mentorship of women in mathematics.<ref name="humphreys">{{cite web|title=Gweneth Humphreys Awards|url=https://awm-math.org/awards/humphreys-award/|publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics|accessdate=26 April 2019}}</ref><ref name="humphreys2015" />  Haas was named an inaugural AWM Fellow in 2017.<ref>{{cite web|title=2018 Inaugural Class of AWM Fellows|url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/2018-awm-fellows|publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics|accessdate=9 January 2021}}</ref> In 2017 she was elected President of the AWM and on February 1, 2019 she assumed that position.<ref>{{cite web |title=History of the AWM |url=https://awm-math.org/about/history/ |publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics |accessdate=27 April 2019}}</ref>

==Education==
Haas received her [[Bachelor of Arts]] from [[Swarthmore College]]<!--in year?-->, her [[Master of Science]] from [[Cornell University]]<!--in year?-->, and her [[Ph.D.]] from [[Cornell University]] in 1987.<ref name="smith-prof-emerita-bio">{{cite web|title=Ruth Haas|url=https://www.smith.edu/academics/faculty/ruth-haas|website=Smith College|accessdate=January 12, 2018|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Ruth Haas|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=44371|website=Mathematics Genealogy Project|accessdate=12 January 2018}}</ref> Prior to becoming a professor at the University of Hawaii, Haas was Achilles Professor of Mathematics and Statistics at [[Smith College]].<ref name="smith">{{cite web|title=Smith Bids Farewell to Retiring Faculty Members|url=https://www.smith.edu/news/2017-retiring-faculty-members/|website=Grécourt Gate|publisher=Smith College|accessdate=January 12, 2018|date=May 26, 2017}}</ref>

==Career==
Ruth Haas taught at Smith College for many years. She was instrumental in establishing the Center for Women in Mathematics and the post-baccalaureate program at Smith. She has developed and supported several other initiatives, including an undergraduate research course, the annual Women In Mathematics In the Northeast (WIMIN) conference, a program for junior visitors, a high school outreach program, and weekly seminars. The AWM honored Ruth Haas’s outstanding achievements in inspiring undergraduate women to discover and pursue their passion for mathematics and eventually becoming mathematicians by awarding her the 2015 M. Gweneth Humphreys Award.<ref name="humphreys2015" />
